name: Miyamura Karin
source:
The older of the Miyamura sisters.

Currently working as an eroge voice actress.

Has appeared in games since their pre-debut days with the agency.

Hades Soft's maiden work served as her break into the scene,
and she has recently become partially affiliated with the agency.

She's recognized as a talented young voice actress.

A childhood friend the same age as the protagonist's older sister Shiiba Sayaka, working part-time at Hades Soft and is often seen there.

Approachable and magnanimous, she's a cheerful woman.

Diligent and hard-working, she never misses her daily lessons.

She's approachable and dependable, but is troubled by adult advances.
